s.d: ἐπ-έκεινα adv. (= ἐπ᾽ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: [[leviticus 22 27|Lev.22:27]], [[numbers 32 19|Num.32:19]], al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;] beyond; with genitive, [[acts 7 43|Act.7:43]] (LXX) † (AS)
ἐπ-εκ-τείνω to extend: mid., to stretch forward: with dative, [[philippians 3 13|Php.3:13.]]† (AS)
ἐπ-εν-δύω = -δύνω (Hdt.), to put on over; pass. (Plut., al.), to have on over, be clothed upon: [[2-corinthians 5 2|2Co.5:2-4.]]† (AS)

ἐπενδύτης, -ου, ὁ (ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִיל [[leviticus 8 7|Lev.8:7]] A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), [[1-kings 18 4|3Ki.18:4]] A, [[2-kings 13 18|4Ki.13:18]] * ;] an outer tunic (RV, coat): [[john 21 7|Jhn.21:7]] .† (AS)

ἐπ-έρχομαι, [in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;] 1. to come to, arrive, come on: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., [[acts 14 19|Act.14:19]] (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, Pr., 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, [[ephesians 2 7|Eph.2:7.]] 2. to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, [[luke 21 26|Luk.21:26]], [[acts 8 24|Act.8:24 13:40]], [[james 5 1|Jas.5:1]]; of an enemy, [[luke 11 22|Luk.11:22;]] of the Holy Spirit, [[luke 1 35|Luk.1:35]], [[acts 1 8|Act.1:8]], [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, [[judges 14 6|Jdg.14:6]], [[1-kings 11 6|3Ki.11:6]], al.].† (AS)

ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;] 1. to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), [[mark 12 34|Mrk.12:34]], [[luke 2 46|Luk.2:46]], al.; with dupl. accusative, [[mark 7 17|Mrk.7:17 11:29]], [[luke 20 40|Luk.20:40]], al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, [[matthew 12 18|Mat.12:18]], [[mark 9 11|Mrk.9:11]]; εἰ, [[mark 8 23|Mrk.8:23]], [[luke 23 6|Luk.23:6]], al.; ἐ. θεόν, [[romans 10 20|Rom.10:20]] (LXX). 2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf., [[matthew 16 1|Mat.16:1]] (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716) (AS)
ἐπ-ερώτημα, -τος, τό [in LXX: Da TH [[daniel 4 14|Dan.4:14]] (שְׁאֵלָא), Sir.33:3 * ;] 1. a question, au inquiry (Hdt., Thuc.). 2. a demand: [[1-peter 3 21|1Pe.3:21]] (see ICC, in l).† (AS)

ἐπ-έχω [in LXX for חָדַל, etc.; also Sir.8:1 34:2, 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 9:25, al. ;] 1. to hold upon. 2. Like παρέχω (as in Hom., al.), to hold out, offer: λόγον ζωῆς, [[philippians 2 16|Php.2:16.]] 3. to hold or direct towards, Sc.νοῦν; (a) absol., to intend, purpose; (b) to observe, give attention to (see MM, Exp., xiv): before πῶς, [[luke 14 7|Luk.14:7;]] with dative of person(s), [[acts 3 5|Act.3:5]], [[1-timothy 4 16|1Ti.4:16]]. 4. to stay, wait: [[acts 19 22|Act.19:22]] (in legal phrase, MM, Exp., l.with).† (AS)
ἐπηρεάζω (ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse), to revile: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 6 28|Luk.6:28;]] with accusative of thing(s) (but see ICC, in l), [[1-peter 3 16|1Pe.3:16.]]† (AS)

ἐπί (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽), prep. with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT), with primary sense of superposition, on, upon. I. C. genitive, 1. of place, answering the question, where? (a) of the place on which, on, upon: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, [[matthew 6 10|Mat.6:10, 19]], al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, [[1-corinthians 11 10|1Co.11:10;]] τ. νεφελῶν, [[matthew 24 3|Mat.24:3]]o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, [[mark 4 26|Mrk.4:26;]] σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, [[hebrews 6 7|Heb.6:7]], al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, [[galatians 3 16|Gal.3:16;]] of power or authority, over, πάντων, [[romans 9 5|Rom.9:5:]] τ. γάζης, [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27;]] ἐξουσία, [[revelation 2 26|Rev.2:26 20:6]]; (b) of vicinity, at, by: τ. θαλάσσης, [[john 6 9|Jhn.6:9;]] τ. ὁδοῦ, [[matthew 21 19|Mat.21:19;]] τοῦ βάτου, [[mark 12 26|Mrk.12:26]] (see Swete, in l.); with genitive of person(s), in the presence of, before, [[matthew 28 14|Mat.28:14]], [[acts 23 30|Act.23:30]], [[1-corinthians 6 1|1Co.6:1]], al. 2. Of time, (a) with genitive of person(s), in the time of: ἐπὶ Ἐλισαίου, [[luke 4 27|Luk.4:27;]] ἐπὶ Κλαυδίου, [[acts 11 28|Act.11:28;]] ἐπὶ Ἀβιάθαρ ἀρχιερέως, when A. was high priest, [[mark 2 26|Mrk.2:26;]] (b) with genitive of thing(s), at, at the time of: [[matthew 1 11|Mat.1:11]], [[hebrews 1 2|Heb.1:2]], [[2-peter 3 3|2Pe.3:3]]; ἐπὶ τ. προσευχῶν, [[romans 1 10|Rom.1:10]], [[ephesians 1 16|Eph.1:16]], [[1-thessalonians 1 2|1Th.1:2]], Phm 4. II. C. dative, of place, answering the question, where? (a) lit., on, upon: [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16, 14:8]], al.; after verbs of motion (see supr., I, 1, (a)), [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16]] [[acts 8 16|Act.8:16]]; above, [[luke 23 38|Luk.23:38;]] at, by, [[mark 13 29|Mrk.13:29]], [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2]], [[acts 5 9|Act.5:9]], al.; (b) metaphorically, upon, on the ground of, [[luke 4 4|Luk.4:4]] (LXX); in the matter of, [[mark 6 52|Mrk.6:52]] (see Swete, in l.); upon, of, concerning, [[acts 5 35|Act.5:35, 40]]; of the ground, reason or motive (Bl., §38, 2; 43, 3), [[matthew 18 3|Mat.18:3 19:9]], [[romans 12 12|Rom.12:12]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, for the reason that, because, [[romans 5 12|Rom.5:12]] [[2-corinthians 5 4|2Co.5:4]]; after verbs of motion, over, [[matthew 18 13|Mat.18:13]], [[romans 16 19|Rom.16:19]], al.; of a condition (cl.), [[romans 8 20|Rom.8:20]], [[1-corinthians 9 10|1Co.9:10]]; ἐπὶ δυσὶ μάρτυσιν (see Westc. on [[hebrews 9 10|Heb.9:10]]), [[hebrews 10 28|Heb.10:28]]; of purpose or aim, [[ephesians 2 10|Eph.2:10]], [[philippians 4 10|Php.4:10]]; of authority, over, [[matthew 24 47|Mat.24:47]] [[luke 12 44|Luk.12:44]]; of hostility, with dative of person(s) (cl.), against, [[luke 12 52|Luk.12:52;]] in addition to (cl.), [[2-corinthians 7 13|2Co.7:13;]] of an adjunct, in, at, on, [[philippians 1 3|Php.1:3 2:17]]. III. C. accusative, 1. of place of motion upon or over, answering the question, whither? (a) lit., upon, over: [[matthew 14 28|Mat.14:28, 29]], [[luke 5 19|Luk.5:19]], al. mult.; in NT also, answering the question, where? (as with genitive, dative), [[mark 4 38|Mrk.4:38 11:2]], [[luke 2 25|Luk.2:25]], [[john 1 32|Jhn.1:32]]; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, [[acts 1 15|Act.1:15 2:1]], al.; of motion to a vicinity, to, [[mark 16 2|Mrk.16:2]], [[acts 8 36|Act.8:36]], al.; (b) metaphorically (in wh. "the accusative is more widely prevalent than it strictly should be," Bl., §43, 1); of blessings, evils, etc., coming upon one, with accusative of person(s), [[matthew 10 13|Mat.10:13 12:28]], [[acts 2 17|Act.2:17]], [[john 18 4|Jhn.18:4]], [[ephesians 5 6|Eph.5:6]], al.; of addition (dative in cl.), λύπη ἐπὶ λύπην, [[philippians 2 27|Php.2:27;]] ἐπικαλεῖν ὄνομα ἐπί (see: ἐπικαλέω), [[acts 15 17|Act.15:17]], [[james 2 7|Jas.2:7]]; καλεῖν ἐπί, to call after, [[luke 1 59|Luk.1:59;]] of number or degree: ἐπὶ τρίς (cl. εἰς τ.), thrice, [[acts 10 16|Act.10:16 11:10]]; ἐπὶ πλεῖον, the more, further, [[acts 4 17|Act.4:17]] [[2-timothy 2 16|2Ti.2:16 3:9]] (see also infr., 2, (a)); ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (see infr., ib.), forasmuch as, [[matthew 25 40|Mat.25:40, 45]], [[romans 11 13|Rom.11:13]]; of power, authority, control, [[luke 1 33|Luk.1:33]], [[acts 7 10|Act.7:10]] [[romans 5 14|Rom.5:14]], [[hebrews 3 6|Heb.3:6]], al.; of the direction of thoughts and feelings, unto, towards, [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17 23:28]], [[acts 9 35|Act.9:35, 42]], [[romans 11 22|Rom.11:22]], [[galatians 4 9|Gal.4:9]], [[ephesians 2 7|Eph.2:7]], [[1-timothy 5 5|1Ti.5:5]], al.; of purpose, for, [[matthew 3 7|Mat.3:7]], [[luke 23 48|Luk.23:48]]; ἐφ᾽ ὅ πάρει (Rec. ἐφ᾽ ᾧ, [[matthew 26 50|Mat.26:50;]] of hostility, against, [[matthew 24 7|Mat.24:7]], [[mark 3 24|Mrk.3:24-26 10:11 13:8]], [[luke 9 5|Luk.9:5]], [[john 13 18|Jhn.13:18]], [[acts 7 54|Act.7:54]], [[1-corinthians 7 36|1Co.7:36]], [[2-corinthians 1 23|2Co.1:23]]; Of reference, concerning, for (cl. usually dative), [[mark 9 12|Mrk.9:12 15:24]], [[john 19 24|Jhn.19:24]], [[romans 4 9|Rom.4:9]]. 2. Of time, (a) during, for: [[luke 4 25|Luk.4:25]] (WH, txt., omits ἐπί), [[acts 13 31|Act.13:31 16:18]], [[hebrews 11 30|Heb.11:30]], al.; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον (χρόνον), as long as, for so long time as, [[mark 9 15|Mrk.9:15]] [[romans 7 1|Rom.7:1]], al. (for ἐφ᾽ ὅ in another sense, see supr., 1, (b)); ἐφ᾽ ἱκανόν (see: ἱ), [[acts 20 11|Act.20:11;]] ἐπὶ πλεῖον (see supr., 1, (b)), yet longer, further, [[acts 20 9|Act.20:9 24:4]]; (b) on, about, towards (cl. εἰς): [[luke 10 35|Luk.10:35]] [[acts 3 1|Act.3:1 4:5]]. IV. In composition, ἐπί signifies: up, ἐπαίρω; upon, ἐπίγειος, ἐπιδημέω, ὠπικαθίζω; towards, επιβλέπω, ὠπεκτείνω; over (of superintendence), ἐπιστάτης; again, in addition, ἐπαιτέω; against, ἐπιορκέω, ἐπιβουλή. (AS)

ἐπι-βαίνω [in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;] 1. to get up on, mount: before ἐπί, with accusative, [[matthew 21 5|Mat.21:5]] (LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: with dative, [[acts 27 2|Act.27:2;]] before εἰς, [[acts 21 6|Act.21:6]] (Rec.); absol., [[acts 21 2|Act.21:2.]] 2. to go up to, go on to, enter: before εἰς, [[acts 20 18|Act.20:18 21:4]]; with dative, [[acts 25 1|Act.25:1.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-βάλλω [in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;] 1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, [[mark 11 7|Mrk.11:7]], [[1-corinthians 7 35|1Co.7:35]]; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, [[revelation 18 10|Rev.18:10]], WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, [[matthew 26 50|Mat.26:50]], [[luke 20 19|Luk.20:19 21:12]], [[john 7 30|Jhn.7:30]], [[acts 5 18|Act.5:18 21:27]]; with dative (Polyb.), [[mark 14 46|Mrk.14:46]] [[acts 4 3|Act.4:3]]; with inf., [[acts 12 1|Act.12:1;]] τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, [[luke 9 62|Luk.9:62;]] ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, [[luke 5 36|Luk.5:36;]] ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16.]] 2. Intrans., (a) to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, [[mark 4 37|Mrk.4:37;]] metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought thereon (sc. τ. ῥήματι), he wept (EV, txt.; R, mg., he began to weep; cf. M, Pr., 131): [[mark 14 72|Mrk.14:72]] (see also Swete, in l); (b) to fall to one's share: τὸ ἐπιβάλλον (sc. dative; Hdt., a1., a technical formula frequently in π.; Deiss., BS, 230, LAE, 152), [[luke 15 12|Luk.15:12.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ to put a burden on, be burdensome: figuratively, absol., [[2-corinthians 2 6|2Co.2:6;]] with accusative of person(s), [[1-thessalonians 2 9|1Th.2:9]], [[2-thessalonians 3 8|2Th.3:8]] (cf. M, Th., I, 29).† (AS)
ἐπι-βιβάζω [in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;] to place upon: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 10 34|Luk.10:34 19:35]], [[acts 23 24|Act.23:24]].† (AS)

ἐπι-βλέπω [in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;] to look upon. In NT, as in LXX ([[1-kings 1 11|1Ki.1:11 9:1]], [[psalms 25 16|Psa.25:16;]] Tob.3:3, al.), to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), [[luke 1 48|Luk.1:48 9:38]], [[james 2 3|Jas.2:3]].† (AS)

ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό [in LXX: [[isaiah 3 22|Isa.3:22]] * ;] 1. that which is thrown over, a cover. 2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with). 3. that which is put on; (a) embroidery; (b) a patch: [[matthew 9 16|Mat.9:16]], [[mark 2 21|Mrk.2:21]], [[luke 5 36|Luk.5:36]].† (AS)
ἐπι-βοάω, -ῶ to cry out: [[acts 25 24|Act.25:24]] (Rec., for βοάω, which see).† (AS)
ἐπι-βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX: [[esther 2 22|Est.2:22]], I [[esther 5 73|Est.5:73]], 2Ma.5:7, al. ;] a plan against, a plot: [[acts 9 24|Act.9:24 20:3, 19 23:30]].† (AS)

ἐπι-γαμβρεύω (γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: [[genesis 34 9|Gen.34:9]], [[1-samuel 18 21|1Ki.18:21]] ff., [[2-chronicles 18 1|2Ch.18:1]], [[esther 9 14|Est.9:14]] (חָתַן hithp.), [[genesis 38 8|Gen.38:8]] R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10:54-56 * ;] 1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. [[genesis 38 8|Gen.38:8]]). 2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. [[genesis 38 8|Gen.38:8]]): with accusative, [[matthew 22 24|Mat.22:24.]]† (AS)

ἐπί-γειος, -ον (ἐπί, γῆ), of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., [[john 3 12|Jhn.3:12]] [[philippians 2 10|Php.2:10 3:19]] (anarth.); σώματα, [[1-corinthians 15 40|1Co.15:40;]] οἰκία, [[2-corinthians 5 1|2Co.5:1;]] σοφία, [[james 3 15|Jas.3:15]] (Cremer, 153).† (AS)
ἐπι-γίνομαι (see: γίνομαι) [in LXX: Ep. [[jeremiah 47 1|Jer.47:1-7]], 3Ma.2:6 * ;] to arrive, arise, come on: [[acts 28 13|Act.28:13.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-γινώσκω [in LXX chiefly for נָכַר: hi., also for יָדַע, etc. ;] "directive" of γινώσκω (AR, Eph., 249), as in cl.; 1. to observe, perceive, discern, recognize; (a) absol.: [[acts 25 10|Act.25:10]], [[1-corinthians 13 12|1Co.13:12]]; before ὅτι, [[luke 1 22|Luk.1:22;]] τ. πνεύματι, before ὅτι, [[mark 2 8|Mrk.2:8;]] (b) with accusative of thing(s): [[luke 1 4|Luk.1:4 5:22]], [[acts 12 14|Act.12:14 27:39]], [[romans 1 32|Rom.1:32]], [[2-corinthians 1 13|2Co.1:13]], [[colossians 1 6|Col.1:6]], [[1-timothy 4 3|1Ti.4:3]]; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, [[mark 5 30|Mrk.5:30;]] before ὅτι, [[1-corinthians 14 37|1Co.14:37;]] (with) with accusative of person(s): [[matthew 11 27|Mat.11:27 14:36 17:12]], [[mark 6 33|Mrk.6:33]] (T, αὐτούς, but LTr., WH, R, omit the prop., and LTr., WH, txt., read ἔγνωσαν), [[mark 6 54|Mrk.6:54]] [[luke 24 16|Luk.24:16, 31]], [[1-corinthians 16 18|1Co.16:18]], [[2-corinthians 1 14|2Co.1:14]]; before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s), [[matthew 7 16|Mat.7:16, 20]]; before ὅτι, [[acts 3 10|Act.3:10 4:13]], [[2-corinthians 13 5|2Co.13:5]]; pass., [[1-corinthians 13 12|1Co.13:12;]] opposite to ἀγνοούμενοι, [[2-corinthians 6 9|2Co.6:9.]] 2. to discover, ascertain, determine: [[acts 9 30|Act.9:30;]] before ὅτι, [[luke 7 37|Luk.7:37 23:7]], [[acts 19 34|Act.19:34 22:29 24:11 28:1]]; with accusative of thing(s), before quæst., [[acts 23 28|Act.23:28;]] δι᾽ ἣν αἰτίαν, [[acts 22 24|Act.22:24;]] παρά, with genitive of person(s), before περ, with genitive of thing(s), [[acts 24 8|Act.24:8;]] τ. ὁδὸν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, [[2-peter 2 21|2Pe.2:21]] (cf. Lft., Col., 136; Cremer, 159; M, Pr., 113; AR, Eph., 248 ff.).† (AS)

ἐπί-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ (ἐπιγινώσκω, which see), [in LXX: [[1-kings 7 14|3Ki.7:14]] (B. γν-), [[proverbs 2 5|Pro.2:5]], [[hosea 4 1|Hos.4:1, 6 6:6]] (דַּעַת), Jdth.9:14, 2Ma.9:11 * ;] acquaintance, discernment, recognition (Plut., al.): [[philippians 1 9|Php.1:9]], [[colossians 3 10|Col.3:10]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[colossians 1 9|Col.1:9 2:2]], Phm 6; τ. ἀληθείας, [[1-timothy 2 4|1Ti.2:4]], [[2-timothy 2 25|2Ti.2:25 3:7]], [[titus 1 1|Tit.1:1]], [[hebrews 10 26|Heb.10:26]]; τ. ἁμαρτίας, [[romans 3 20|Rom.3:20;]] with genitive of person(s), of God: [[ephesians 1 17|Eph.1:17]], [[colossians 1 10|Col.1:10]], [[2-peter 1 2|2Pe.1:2-3]]; of Christ: [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]], [[2-peter 1 8|2Pe.1:8 2:20]]; of God and Christ: [[2-peter 1 2|2Pe.1:2;]] κατ ̓ ἐ., [[romans 10 2|Rom.10:2;]] ἔχειν ἐν ἐ., [[romans 1 28|Rom.1:28]] (see AR, Eph., 248 ff.; and for a somewhat different view, Thayer, see word; Lft. on Col, 1:9; Tr., Syn., LXXv; Cremer, 159 f.; cf. αἴσθησις).† (AS)
ἐπι-γραφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἐπιγράφω), an inscription: [[matthew 22 20|Mat.22:20]], [[mark 12 16|Mrk.12:16 15:26]], [[luke 20 24|Luk.20:24 23:33]].† (AS)

ἐπι-γράφω [in LXX for כָּתַב, [[numbers 17 2|Num.17:2;]] fig., [[jeremiah 31 33|Jer.31:33]], al. ;] to write upon, inscribe: [[mark 15 26|Mrk.15:26]], [[acts 17 23|Act.17:23]], [[revelation 21 12|Rev.21:12]]; figuratively, [[hebrews 8 10|Heb.8:10]] (LXX) [[hebrews 10 16|Heb.10:16.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-δείκνυμι [in LXX: [[proverbs 12 17|Pro.12:17]] (פּוּחַ hi.), [[isaiah 37 26|Isa.37:26]] (בּוֹא hi.), Esp. Jer.59, 2Ma.15:32, al ;] 1. to show, exhibit, display: with accusative and dative, [[matthew 16 1|Mat.16:1 22:19 24:1]], [[luke 17 14|Luk.17:14]]. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. El., § 55, 1): [[acts 9 39|Act.9:39.]] 2. to show, point out, prove: with accusative, [[hebrews 6 17|Heb.6:17;]] with accusative and inf., [[acts 18 28|Act.18:28]] (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).† (AS)

ἐπι-δέχομαι [in LXX: Jdth.13:13 B2, 1Ma.10:1 1Mac 14:23, Sir.51:26, al. ;] 1. in cl., of things, to allow of, admit of (Dem., Arist., al.). In late writers, 2. to accept besides (Polyb.), to accept (in π. of the terms of a lease; see ICC, on 3Jo, l.with): III Jn 9. 3. (a) to receive besides (Menand.); (b) to receive hospitably (1Mac, Sir, ll with): III Jn 10† (AS)

ἐπι-δημέω, -ῶ (δῆμος); 1. to be at home (Thuc., Plat., al.), 2. to stay in a place, sojourn (Plat., Xen., al.; and see MM, Exp., xiv): [[acts 2 10|Act.2:10 17:21]]; before ἐν, [[acts 18 27|Act.18:27]] (WH, mg.).† (AS)
ἐπι-δια-τάσσομαι to add provisions to a document: [[galatians 3 15|Gal.3:15]] (cf. ἐπιδιαθήκη, a second will, F1J, BJ, ii, 2, 3; the word is used of wills in π., cf. Deiss., LAE, 87).† (AS)

ἐπι-δίδωμι [in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;] 1. to give over, to hand: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[matthew 7 9|Mat.7:9, 19]], [[luke 11 11|Luk.11:11-12 24:30, 42]], [[acts 15 30|Act.15:30]]; pass. with dative of person(s), [[luke 4 17|Luk.4:17.]] 2. to give in, give way: absol., [[acts 27 15|Act.27:15.]]† (AS)
ἐπι-δι-ορθόω to set in order further: [[titus 1 5|Tit.1:5]] (Inscr.; Cremer, 8O8).† (AS)

(Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning. 1. ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.). 2. (a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.); (b) ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.with The EV, daily, is based on the Vg. (Lk; OL, Mt, Lk, quotidianus). "It is difficult not to think that τὸν ἐ. rests upon misunderstanding of an original Aramaic phrase, or upon a Greek corruption" (ICC on Mt, l.with; cf. also Cremer, 239).† (AS)

Sir.7:35); (b) in LXX and NT (as פָּקַד in [[genesis 21 1|Gen.21:1]], [[exodus 4 31|Exo.4:31]], [[psalms 8 5|Psa.8:5]], al.), to visit with help, to care for: [[luke 1 68|Luk.1:68, 78 7:16]], [[acts 15 14|Act.15:14]], [[hebrews 2 6|Heb.2:6]]; (with) to visit with punishment ([[jeremiah 9 25|Jer.9:25]], [[psalms 89 33|Psa.89:33]], al.; cf. MM, Exp., xiv; Cremer, 863).† (AS)
ἐπι-σκηνόω, -ῶ to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over: metaphorically, before ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ (RV, rest upon, cover), [[2-corinthians 12 9|2Co.12:9.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-σκιάζω [in LXX: [[exodus 40 35|Exo.40:35]] (שָׁכַן), [[psalms 91 4|Psa.91:4 140:7]] (סָכַךְ), [[proverbs 18 11|Pro.18:11]] * ;] to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: with dative, [[acts 5 15|Act.5:15;]] of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. [[exodus 40 29|Exo.40:29, 35]], 2Ma.2:8) cloud, with dative, [[mark 9 7|Mrk.9:7;]] with accusative, [[matthew 17 5|Mat.17:5]], [[luke 9 34|Luk.9:34]]; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, [[luke 1 35|Luk.1:35.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ [in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;] 1. to look upon, observe, examine: before μή, [[hebrews 12 16|Heb.12:16.]] 2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: [[1-peter 5 2|1Pe.5:2]] (R, txt.; WH cm.; Cremer, 527).† (AS)

ἐπι-σκοπή, -ῆς, ἡ [in LXX chiey for פָּקַד פְּקֻדָּה ;] 1. a visiting, visitation (εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after Heb.), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment ([[leviticus 19 20|Lev.19:20]] [[job 10 12|Job.10:12]], [[jeremiah 6 15|Jer.6:15]], Wis.2:20, al.): [[luke 19 44|Luk.19:44]], [[1-peter 2 12|1Pe.2:12]] (see Hort, in l). 2. office, charge, esp. office of an ἐπίσκοιος (which see): [[acts 1 20|Act.1:20]] (LXX), [[1-timothy 3 1|1Ti.3:1]] (Cremer, 527 f., 864; DCG, ii, 809b).† (AS)

ἐπί-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ (σκοπός, a watcher), [in LXX for פָּקַד, its parts and derivatives, [[numbers 4 16|Num.4:16 31:14]], [[judges 9 28|Jdg.9:28]], [[2-kings 11 15|4Ki.11:15 11:18]], [[2-chronicles 34 12|2Ch.34:12 34:17]], [[nehemiah 11 9|Neh.11:9, 14 11:22]]; אֵל, [[job 20 29|Job.20:29;]] נָגַשׂ:, [[isaiah 60 17|Isa.60:17;]] Wis.1:6, 1Ma.1:51 * ;] a superintendent, guardian, overseer (cl.; for exx. see LS, see word): [[acts 20 28|Act.20:28]], [[1-peter 2 25|1Pe.2:25]] (ICC, in l); as technical term for a religious office (Deiss., BS, 230 f.), in later Paul. epp. of the head of a church (Vg. episcopus), a bishop: [[philippians 1 1|Php.1:1]], [[1-timothy 3 2|1Ti.3:2]], [[titus 1 7|Tit.1:7]] (see reff. see word ἐπισκοπή).† (AS)

ἐπι-σπάω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[isaiah 5 18|Isa.5:18]] (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;] to draw on: mid., in peculiar sense of effacing signs of Judaism (cf. 1Ma.1:15, FlJ, Ant., xii, 5, i; see Thayer, see word), to become as uncircumcised: [[1-corinthians 7 18|1Co.7:18.]]† (AS)

ἐπίσταμαι (prob. an old mid, of ἐφίστημι, which see), [in LXX chiefly for יָדַע ;] to know, know of, understand: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 19 15|Act.19:15;]] with ptcp., [[acts 24 10|Act.24:10;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[mark 14 68|Mrk.14:68]], [[acts 18 25|Act.18:25]], [[1-timothy 6 4|1Ti.6:4]], [[james 4 14|Jas.4:14]], Ju 10; before περί, [[acts 26 26|Act.26:26;]] ὅτι, [[acts 15 7|Act.15:7 19:25 22:19]]; ὡς, [[acts 10 28|Act.10:28;]] πῶς, [[acts 20 18|Act.20:18;]] ποῦ, [[hebrews 11 8|Heb.11:8.]]† SYN: γινώσκω (which see), οἶδα (AS)

ἐπιστάτης, -ου, ό (ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 4Ki.25:19, [[jeremiah 29 26|Jer.29:26 52:25]] (פָּקִיד), [[2-chronicles 31 12|2Ch.31:12]] (נָגִיד), 2Ma.5:22, etc. ;] a chief, commander, master: [[luke 5 5|Luk.5:5 8:24, 45 9:33, 49 17:13]] (cf. Dalman, Words, 336 ff.).† (AS)

ἐπι-στέλλω [in LXX: 3Ki.5:8 [[nehemiah 6 19|Neh.6:19]] (שָׁלַח), Jdth.15:4, 1Ma.10:25 1Mac 12:7 1Mac 13:18 (in each case with seel. ἀποσ-) * ;] 1. to send to. 2. to send a message by letter, to write word (MM, Exp., xiv): with dative of person(s), [[acts 21 25|Act.21:25]], [[hebrews 13 22|Heb.13:22]]; before τοῦ, with inf., [[acts 15 20|Act.15:20.]]† (AS)

ἐπιστήμων, -ον, genitive, -ονoς (ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 1 13|Deu.1:13 4:6]], [[isaiah 5 21|Isa.5:21]] (בִּין ni.), I [[esther 8 44|Est.8:44]], Sir.10:25 21:15, etc. ;] knowing, skilled: [[james 3 13|Jas.3:13.]]† (AS)
ἐπι-στηρίζω [in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;] to make stronger, confirm: with accusative, [[acts 14 22|Act.14:22 15:32, 41]].† (AS)

ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; frequently in Mac ;] 1. a message. 2. a letter, an epistle: [[acts 9 2|Act.9:2]], [[1-corinthians 5 9|1Co.5:9]], al.; pl., [[acts 22 5|Act.22:5]], [[1-corinthians 16 3|1Co.16:3]], al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, [[2-corinthians 3 1|2Co.3:1]] (cf. Milligan, NTD, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, Th., 121 ff.; NTD, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.) (AS)
ἐπι-στομίζω (στόμα), to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: [[titus 1 11|Tit.1:11.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-στρέφω [very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;] 1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): [[luke 1 16|Luk.1:16-17]] (cf. [[malachi 3 24|Mal.3:24]]), [[james 5 19|Jas.5:19-20.]] 2. Intrans., (a) to turn, turn oneself around: [[acts 16 18|Act.16:18;]] with inf., [[revelation 1 12|Rev.1:12;]] before πρός, [[acts 9 40|Act.9:40;]] so also pass. (cl.), [[mark 5 30|Mrk.5:30 8:33]], [[john 21 20|Jhn.21:20]]; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), [[acts 9 35|Act.9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20]]; πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[1-thessalonians 1 9|1Th.1:9]], [[2-corinthians 3 16|2Co.3:16]]; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, [[acts 26 18|Act.26:18;]] pass., [[1-peter 2 25|1Pe.2:25;]] (b) to return (as in MGr.): [[luke 8 55|Luk.8:55]], [[acts 15 36|Act.15:36]]; before ὀπίσω, with inf., [[matthew 24 18|Mat.24:18;]] before εἰς, [[matthew 12 44|Mat.12:44]], [[mark 13 16|Mrk.13:16]], [[luke 2 39|Luk.2:39 17:31]]; ἐπί, [[2-peter 2 22|2Pe.2:22;]] metaphorically, before ἐπί, [[galatians 4 9|Gal.4:9;]] πρός, [[luke 17 4|Luk.17:4;]] of moral reform, [[matthew 13 15|Mat.13:15]], [[mark 4 12|Mrk.4:12]], [[luke 22 32|Luk.22:32]], [[acts 3 19|Act.3:19 28:27]]; pass., [[matthew 10 13|Mat.10:13]] (Cremer, 531, 881).† (AS)
ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: [[ezekiel 47 7|Eze.47:7]] (שׁוּב), Sir.18:21 49:2, etc. ;] a turning about; metaphorically, conversion (Field, Notes, 246): [[acts 15 3|Act.15:3.]]† (AS)

ἐπι-συν-άγω [in LXX for אָסַף, קָבַץ, etc. (Cremer, 65) ;] 1. to gather together: [[matthew 23 37|Mat.23:37 24:31]], [[mark 13 27|Mrk.13:27]], [[luke 13 34|Luk.13:34]]; pass., [[mark 1 33|Mrk.1:33]], [[luke 12 1|Luk.12:1 17:37]], (cf. [[psalms 102 23|Psa.102:23 106:47]], 2Ma.1:27, al.). 2. to gather together against ([[micah 4 11|Mic.4:11]], [[zechariah 12 3|Zec.12:3]], 1Ma.3:58, al.).† (AS)
ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ (ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:7 * ;] a gathering together, assembly: [[hebrews 10 25|Heb.10:25;]] before ἐπί, [[2-thessalonians 2 1|2Th.2:1]] (cf. 2Mac, l.with).† (AS)
ἐπι-συν-τρέχω to run together again: [[mark 9 25|Mrk.9:25]] (see Swete, in l).† (AS)

ἐπι-σύστασις, -εως, ἡ (ἐπισυνίστημι) [in LXX: [[numbers 16 40|Num.16:40]] (עֵדָה) [[numbers 26 9|Num.26:9]] (נָצָה hi.), I [[esther 5 73|Est.5:73]] A* ;] a gathering, a riotous throng: Rec. (for ἐπίστασις, which see), [[acts 24 12|Act.24:12]], [[2-corinthians 11 28|2Co.11:28]].† (AS)
